Load Balancing Approaches and Techniques

负载均衡的方法与技术

In the quest for scalability and to ensure uninterrupted availability of services, organizations have adopted horizontal and vertical scaling techniques, as discussed in Chapter 1. These methods have addressed some of the scalability challenges, but they do not guarantee continuous service availability. The rapid growth of the internet and the need for modern high-traffic websites to handle hundreds of thousands of concurrent requests necessitate a more robust approach.

在追求可扩展性、并确保服务不中断可用的过程中，各组织采用了第 1 章讨论过的水平扩展和垂直扩展技术。这些方法解决了部分可扩展性挑战，但它们并不能保证服务持续可用。互联网的快速增长、以及现代高流量网站需要处理数十万并发请求的需求，使得我们必须采用一种更健壮的方法。

When a single server is responsible for handling all incoming requests, it becomes overloaded, which can lead to system failures. To overcome this limitation, we horizontally scale the system. Then, load balancing comes into play to efficiently distribute incoming network traffic across the group of backend servers, often referred to as a server pool. This is much like starting up a company on your own and later hiring more people (and distributing the tasks among them) to scale the business.

当单台服务器负责处理所有进入的请求时，它会过载，这可能导致系统故障。为克服这一限制，我们对系统做水平扩展。这时负载均衡就登场了，它把进入的网络流量高效地分发到一组后端服务器上，这组服务器通常被称为服务器池（server pool）。这很像你自己一个人创办公司，后来再招聘更多人（并把任务分配给他们）来扩展业务。

In this chapter, we will start with understanding different networking components for managing traffic and improving performance. We will then focus on the concept of load balancers (LBs), which play a crucial role in achieving efficient load distribution and ensuring high availability of services. We will delve into the mechanisms of load balancing as well as the various load balancing algorithms employed and their respective strengths and weaknesses. Understanding LBs and their functionality enhances organizations' ability to handle increasing loads, scale their infrastructure, and deliver a seamless experience to their users or clients. Finally, you'll learn about a popular open source load balancing solution. So let's get started with the different networking components.

在本章中，我们将先了解用于管理流量和提升性能的各种网络组件。然后我们会聚焦于负载均衡器（LB）的概念，它在实现高效负载分发和确保服务高可用方面扮演关键角色。我们将深入研究负载均衡的机制、所采用的各种负载均衡算法及其各自的优缺点。理解 LB 及其功能，能增强组织应对不断增长的负载、扩展基础设施、并向用户或客户交付无缝体验的能力。最后，你会了解一种流行的开源负载均衡解决方案。那么我们从各种网络组件开始吧。

Networking Components

In the realm of networking and web services, several components play crucial roles in managing and optimizing traffic flow, scaling, enhancing security, and improving performance. Four such components are forward proxies, reverse proxies, LBs, and API gateways, illustrated in Figure 5-1.

在网络和 Web 服务领域，有若干组件在管理和优化流量、扩展、增强安全性以及提升性能方面扮演关键角色。其中四个组件是：正向代理、反向代理、LB 和 API 网关，如图 5-1 所示。

Although they share some similarities, each of these components serves a distinct purpose and operates at a different level within a network architecture. Let's explore the differences between them:

尽管它们有一些相似之处，但每个组件都服务于不同目的，并在网络架构中处于不同层次。下面我们来探讨它们之间的差异：

Load balancer

An LB is a crucial component in network architecture that distributes incoming network traffic across multiple servers to enhance the performance and accessibility of applications, websites, or databases. It plays a dual role: monitoring resource statuses while orchestrating the flow of requests. When a server is unresponsive, is incapable of handling new requests, or exhibits an increased error rate, the LB halts traffic to that server and routes it to another available server. LBs can operate at various layers of the Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model, including L4 (transport layer) and L7 (application layer), and they use different algorithms to distribute traffic based on factors like server load, response time, and even geographic proximity.

LB 是网络架构中的关键组件，它把进入的网络流量分发到多台服务器上，以提升应用、网站或数据库的性能和可访问性。它扮演双重角色：监控资源状态，同时编排请求的流动。当某台服务器无响应、无法处理新请求、或错误率上升时，LB 停止向该服务器发送流量，并把流量路由到另一台可用服务器。LB 可以在开放式系统互联（OSI）模型的不同层运行，包括 L4（传输层）和 L7（应用层），并使用不同算法、根据服务器负载、响应时间甚至地理邻近度等因素来分发流量。

Page 142
The OSI model describes seven layers that computer systems use to communicate over the network, which we will cover in more detail in Chapter 6. AWS offers Elastic Load Balancers (ELBs) in different types as application, network, and gateway LBs, which we will cover in more detail in Chapter 9.
OSI 模型描述了计算机系统用于通过网络通信的七层模型，我们将在第 6 章详细介绍。AWS 提供 Elastic Load Balancer（ELB），分为应用层、网络层和网关 LB 等不同类型，我们将在第 9 章详细介绍。

Reverse proxy

A reverse proxy sits as a gateway between the internet and web servers, intercepting incoming requests from clients and routing them to the appropriate backend servers. Reverse proxies are commonly used to improve security by hiding backend server details from clients. They also improve scalability and performance by offloading tasks like Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) termination, content caching, compression, and load balancing from backend servers.

反向代理作为网关位于互联网与 Web 服务器之间，拦截来自客户端的进入请求，并把它们路由到合适的后端服务器。反向代理常用于通过向客户端隐藏后端服务器细节来提升安全性。它们还通过从后端服务器卸下 SSL（安全套接层）终结、内容缓存、压缩和负载均衡等任务，来提升可扩展性和性能。

Forward proxy

In contrast to a reverse proxy, a forward proxy acts as an intermediary between client devices and the internet, mediating the traffic in between. When a client sends a request to access a web resource, the request is first intercepted by the forward proxy. The proxy then forwards the request to the internet on behalf of the client. Forward proxies are commonly used to enforce corporate access control policies, filter web content, improve privacy and security by masking client IP addresses, and cache frequently accessed content. Thus, they are often deployed within corporate networks to manage outbound web traffic.

与反向代理相反，正向代理充当客户端设备与互联网之间的中介，居间调解流量。当客户端发送请求访问某个 Web 资源时，请求先被正向代理拦截。然后代理代表客户端把请求转发到互联网。正向代理常用于实施企业访问控制策略、过滤 Web 内容、通过隐藏客户端 IP 地址来提升隐私和安全性，以及缓存频繁访问的内容。因此，它们常被部署在企业网络内，用于管理出站 Web 流量。

API gateway

An API gateway is a specialized type of reverse proxy acting as a facade that provides a single unified entry point for client applications to access multiple backend services or APIs. API gateways streamline API management by enforcing security policies, rate limiting, authentication, authorization, request and response transformations, protocol translation, and content negotiation. They are commonly used in microservice architectures to abstract complexities and provide a unified interface for client applications. They are useful for managing the API lifecycle, including versioning, documentation, and monitoring.

API 网关是一种专用的反向代理，充当门面（facade），为客户端应用访问多个后端服务或 API 提供单一统一入口。API 网关通过实施安全策略、限流、认证、授权、请求与响应转换、协议转换和内容协商，来简化 API 管理。它们常用于微服务架构中，以抽象复杂性并为客户端应用提供统一接口。它们对于管理 API 生命周期很有用，包括版本管理、文档和监控。

AWS offers Amazon API Gateway as a fully managed service that makes it easy for developers to create, publish, maintain, monitor, and secure APIs at any scale, which we will cover in more detail in Chapter 9.
AWS 提供了 Amazon API Gateway 这一全托管服务，让开发者可以轻松地在任意规模上创建、发布、维护、监控和保护 API，我们将在第 9 章详细介绍。

Understanding the differences between these networking components is essential for designing robust, scalable, and secure architectures for modern applications and services. Each component plays a distinct role in managing and optimizing traffic flow within a network environment. This chapter will cover load balancing in detail

理解这些网络组件之间的差异，对于为现代应用和服务设计健壮、可扩展、安全的架构至关重要。每个组件在网络环境中管理和优化流量方面都扮演不同角色。本章将详细介绍负载均衡，

as these other components are integrated along with LBs for additional benefits. Let's first delve into the benefits of load balancing.

因为这些其他组件会与 LB 集成在一起以获得额外收益。我们先深入看看负载均衡的好处。

Benefits of Load Balancing

Load balancing offers several advantages in the realm of network and application performance:

在网络和应用性能领域，负载均衡带来以下几项优势：

Scalability

LBs facilitate the seamless addition and removal of servers to a network, enabling easy scalability as the demand for services grows or decreases. This can be implemented based on autoscaling policies, which we'll discuss in more detail in Chapter 11.

LB 方便向网络中无缝地添加和移除服务器，从而在服务需求增长或下降时轻松扩展。这可以基于自动扩展策略来实现，我们将在第 11 章详细讨论。

High availability

With load balancing, applications and websites can maintain high availability by rerouting traffic away from servers that may be temporarily unavailable because of maintenance or other issues.

通过负载均衡，应用和网站可以把流量从因维护或其他问题而暂时不可用的服务器上重定向走，从而维持高可用。

Enhanced performance

By spreading incoming traffic across multiple servers, load balancing prevents any single server from becoming overwhelmed. This helps maintain optimal performance (or throughput) and responsiveness (or latency) for users accessing applications or websites.

通过把进入的流量分散到多台服务器上，负载均衡防止任何单台服务器被压垮。这有助于为访问应用或网站的用户维持最优性能（即吞吐量）和响应能力（即延迟）。

Improved fault tolerance

Distributing traffic among multiple servers minimizes the risk of a single point of failure. If one server encounters issues or fails, the LB redirects traffic to healthy servers, maintaining service continuity and leading to high availability.

把流量分发到多台服务器上，最大程度降低了单点故障的风险。如果某台服务器遇到问题或故障，LB 把流量重定向到健康的服务器，维持服务连续性，从而带来高可用。

Optimized resource utilization

Load balancing ensures that resources are used efficiently by distributing the workload evenly among servers, preventing any from being underutilized or overburdened. The even load distribution can be dependent on the chosen algorithm, but the idea behind an LB is balancing load among all the servers, ensuring their optimal utilization.

负载均衡通过把工作负载均匀地分发到各服务器之间来确保资源被高效使用，防止任何服务器被利用不足或过载。均匀的负载分发可能取决于所选算法，但 LB 背后的理念是在所有服务器之间平衡负载，确保它们被最优利用。

Advanced LBs even offer the capability of routing traffic according to users' geographic locations, optimizing performance and adhering to local regulations. Moreover, LBs functioning as reverse proxies can be expanded to serve as a protective shield against specific cyberthreats by scrutinizing incoming traffic and detecting and blocking potentially harmful requests. The feature gaps between services like the LB and the API gateway have narrowed over the years, and the feature set can be very specific to the LB or API gateway solution. We recommend stateless backend servers behind the LB to ensure no data loss when an existing server is removed from

高级 LB 甚至提供根据用户地理位置路由流量的能力，以优化性能并遵守当地法规。此外，充当反向代理的 LB 可以扩展为抵御特定网络威胁的保护层，方法是仔细审查进入的流量、检测并阻止潜在有害请求。这些年来，LB 与 API 网关等服务之间的功能差距已经缩小，功能集可能因具体的 LB 或 API 网关方案而非常具体。我们建议在 LB 后面使用无状态后端服务器，以确保当现有服务器被移出

Page 144

the pool. LB deployment strategies also play a pivotal role in ensuring optimal performance, high availability, and efficient resource utilization within complex network architectures.

服务器池时不会丢失数据。LB 部署策略在复杂网络架构中确保最优性能、高可用和高效资源利用方面也扮演关键角色。

LB Deployment and Placement Strategies

Load balancing is not just required within a data center network but also can be deployed at both a global and a local scale. The choice between global and local load balancing and the strategic placement of LBs between web servers, application servers, and database servers significantly affect the reliability and responsiveness of distributed systems.

负载均衡不仅在数据中心网络内部需要，还可以在全局和本地两个尺度上部署。全局与本地负载均衡之间的选择、以及 LB 在 Web 服务器、应用服务器和数据库服务器之间的策略性放置，都会显著影响分布式系统的可靠性和响应能力。

Global Server Load Balancing

Global server load balancing (GSLB) operates at a larger scale, typically by distributing traffic across different data centers or geographical regions. It optimizes the user experience by directing requests to the nearest or most available data center. This strategy is fundamental for serving content to users worldwide, improving performance, and ensuring compliance with regional regulations.

全局服务器负载均衡（GSLB）在更大尺度上运作，通常通过把流量分发到不同数据中心或地理区域来实现。它通过把请求引导到最近或最可用的数据中心来优化用户体验。这种策略对于向全球用户提供内容、提升性能以及确保遵守区域法规都至关重要。

There are three approaches to GSLB:

GSLB 有三种实现方式：

  • ADC-based GSLB. Application delivery controllers (ADCs) are computer network devices in a data center, often part of an application delivery network (ADN) that manages traffic flow to the servers. Some ADCs have a real-time view of the servers and forward requests based on the health and capacity of the data center.
    基于 ADC 的 GSLB。应用交付控制器（ADC）是数据中心中的计算机网络设备，通常是应用交付网络（ADN）的一部分，管理发往服务器的流量。有些 ADC 对服务器有实时视图，并根据数据中心的健康状况和容量转发请求。
  • DNS-based GSLB. GSLB performed by DNS involves analyzing the client's IP location. Whenever a user requests the IP address for a domain name, DNS-based GSLB directs the user to the IP address of the data center geographically nearest to the user's location.
    基于 DNS 的 GSLB。由 DNS 执行的 GSLB 涉及分析客户端的 IP 地理位置。每当用户请求某个域名的 IP 地址时，基于 DNS 的 GSLB 就把用户引导到地理位置上离用户最近的数据中心的 IP 地址。
  • CDN-based GSLB. GSLB implementation can also be done through CDN, where a global CDN service gathers data from clients' original servers and stores it across a network of servers spread geographically, ensuring swift, dependable distribution of online static content to users across the globe.
    基于 CDN 的 GSLB。GSLB 的实现也可以通过 CDN 完成，即由一个全球 CDN 服务从客户端的原始服务器收集数据，并把它存储在跨地理分布的服务器网络上，确保向全球用户快速、可靠地分发在线静态内容。

Local Load Balancing

In contrast, local load balancing manages traffic within a specific data center or a localized network, functioning akin to reverse proxies. It balances the load among servers within the same geographical region or network segment. This strategy is

与之相对，本地负载均衡在特定数据中心或局部网络内管理流量，功能类似于反向代理。它在同一地理区域或网段内的服务器之间平衡负载。这种策略

Page 145

critical for optimizing internal network traffic, ensuring efficient resource utilization, and maintaining high availability within a specific infrastructure. Clients' requests seamlessly connect to the LB, which operates using a virtual IP (VIP) address.

对于优化内部网络流量、确保高效资源利用以及在特定基础设施内维持高可用都至关重要。客户端的请求无缝地连接到 LB，LB 使用一个虚拟 IP（VIP）地址运行。

A VIP is an address not directly tied to a physical machine; instead, multiple machines share the same VIP. If a network interface fails, the packets directed to it are typically lost. However, with a VIP, packets are automatically redirected to a failover machine. Externally, a VIP appears as a singular machine, while internally, a group of machines uses the same address. Typically, DNS queries are answered with VIPs, contributing to seamless rerouting of traffic and ensuring robust failover capabilities.
VIP（虚拟 IP）是一个不直接绑定到某台物理机器的地址；相反，多台机器共享同一个 VIP。如果某个网络接口故障，发往它的数据包通常会丢失。然而，使用 VIP 时，数据包会自动重定向到一台故障切换机器。从外部看，VIP 像一台单一机器；而在内部，一组机器使用同一地址。通常，DNS 查询会以 VIP 作答，这有助于流量的无缝重路由并确保健壮的故障切换能力。

Normally, an LB operates between the client and the server, receiving incoming network and application traffic and then distributing it among several backend servers using different algorithms. In a three-tier architecture, LBs can be placed between the server instances of the three tiers, as shown in Figure 5-2.

通常，LB 运行在客户端与服务器之间，接收进入的网络和应用流量，然后使用不同算法把它们分发到多台后端服务器。在三层架构中，LB 可以放在三层的服务器实例之间，如图 5-2 所示。

LBs placed between clients and web servers serve as the entry point for incoming user requests. They distribute web traffic across multiple web servers, optimizing response times and preventing any single server from becoming overwhelmed. This ensures efficient handling of user requests, improving the overall performance and reliability of web-based services.

放在客户端与 Web 服务器之间的 LB 充当进入用户请求的入口。它们把 Web 流量分发到多台 Web 服务器上，优化响应时间并防止任何单台服务器被压垮。这确保高效处理用户请求，提升基于 Web 服务的整体性能和可靠性。

LBs positioned between web and application servers manage the flow of requests within an application layer. They evenly distribute requests among multiple application servers, ensuring that no single server is overburdened. This setup enhances the

放在 Web 服务器与应用服务器之间的 LB 管理应用层内的请求流。它们在多台应用服务器之间均匀分发请求，确保没有单台服务器过载。这种设置增强了

Page 146

scalability, fault tolerance, and performance of applications, effectively handling user interactions and functionalities.

应用的可扩展性、容错能力和性能，高效处理用户交互和功能。

While less common, placing LBs between application and database servers can be beneficial for read-heavy workloads. They can distribute read queries among multiple database servers, optimizing read performance and scaling database operations. Identifying a read versus a write query can be achieved in an application LB (L7) using URL paths, and routing can be done on the same. The routing can also be done based on HTTP methods; for example, GET /path is routed to server A and POST /path is routed to service B. We'll discuss HTTP methods more in Chapter 6. Load balancing between database servers requires careful consideration because of data consistency and synchronization concerns.

虽然不太常见，但把 LB 放在应用服务器与数据库服务器之间对于读密集型工作负载可能有益。它们可以把读查询分发到多台数据库服务器上，优化读性能并扩展数据库操作。在读查询与写查询之间做区分，可以在应用层 LB（L7）中使用 URL 路径来实现，路由也据此进行。路由还可以基于 HTTP 方法进行；例如，GET /path 被路由到服务器 A，POST /path 被路由到服务 B。我们将在第 6 章更多地讨论 HTTP 方法。由于数据一致性和同步方面的考量，数据库服务器之间的负载均衡需要仔细斟酌。

The strategic placement of LBs between different infrastructure layers is crucial for maintaining balance, optimizing resource utilization, and ensuring high availability. Careful consideration of traffic patterns, application requirements, and system architecture is essential for determining the most effective deployment strategy and placement of LBs.

把 LB 策略性地放在不同基础设施层之间，对于维持平衡、优化资源利用和确保高可用至关重要。仔细考虑流量模式、应用需求和系统架构，对于确定最有效的 LB 部署策略和位置至关重要。

Load balancing as a concept revolves around distributing tasks among available workers, with no single prescribed method of distribution. Consequently, there are multiple load balancing algorithms, each offering a different approach to distributing the workload.

负载均衡这一概念围绕在可用的工作者之间分发任务展开，并没有唯一规定的分发方法。因此，存在多种负载均衡算法，每种都提供一种不同的分发工作负载的方式。

Load Balancing Algorithms

Load balancing algorithms are fundamental to the efficient distribution of incoming traffic across multiple servers. These algorithms can be categorized as static or dynamic. Each offers distinct methods of balancing the load and optimizing resource utilization. Let's explore various load balancing algorithms, their characteristics, and how they influence the distribution of traffic.

负载均衡算法是把进入流量高效分发到多台服务器的基础。这些算法可以分为静态或动态两类。每类都提供不同的平衡负载和优化资源利用的方法。下面我们探讨各种负载均衡算法、它们的特征，以及它们如何影响流量分发。

Static Load Balancing Algorithms

Static algorithms make load assignments based on existing knowledge of server configurations, disregarding changes in server states at runtime. They are less complex and are typically implemented in a single router or commodity machine where all requests converge. Some well-known static load balancing algorithms include:

静态算法基于对服务器配置的既有知识来做负载分配，而不考虑运行时服务器状态的变化。它们复杂度较低，通常实现在所有请求汇聚的单台路由器或通用机器上。一些著名的静态负载均衡算法包括：

Round robin

This algorithm distributes incoming requests equally among servers in a sequential manner. Each server receives a request in turn, ensuring a balanced workload distribution. However, it doesn't consider server load or response times, potentially leading to uneven resource utilization.

这种算法按顺序把进入的请求平均分发到各服务器。每台服务器依次接收一个请求，确保工作负载分发均衡。然而，它不考虑服务器负载或响应时间，可能导致资源利用不均。

Page 147

Weighted round robin

Like round robin, this algorithm assigns different weights to servers based on their capabilities or capacities. The traffic is proportionately divided between the servers based on the weights, making it beneficial for balancing workloads on servers with varying capacities. In most scenarios, though, all the machines in a cluster have identical configurations for consistency, and hence a simple round-robin algorithm is used.

与 round robin 类似，这种算法根据服务器的能力或容量为它们分配不同权重。流量根据权重按比例在各服务器之间分配，这对于在容量不同的服务器之间平衡工作负载很有益。不过在大多数场景中，集群中的所有机器为了一致性都有相同配置，因此使用简单的 round-robin 算法。

Hash-based algorithms

These algorithms use specific attributes from the request (like the source IP or content) to generate a hash key, which is then mapped to a server. This ensures that requests with similar attributes are consistently directed to the same server, aiding in session persistence. This algorithm is rarely used because of issues faced when rebalancing servers in the pool: the server mapping needs to be reorganized upon the addition or removal of servers and could lead to some servers getting too much traffic compared to others.

这些算法使用请求中的特定属性（例如源 IP 或内容）来生成一个哈希键，然后把它映射到某台服务器。这确保具有相似属性的请求被一致地引导到同一台服务器，有助于会话保持。这种算法很少使用，因为在重新平衡池中的服务器时会遇到问题：添加或移除服务器时需要重新组织服务器映射，这可能导致某些服务器分到的流量比其他服务器多太多。

Dynamic Load Balancing Algorithms

Dynamic algorithms make load assignments based on current or recent server states. They engage in communication with servers, incurring communication overhead. Maintaining state information significantly complicates the algorithm's design, resulting in better request-forwarding decisions. Some well-known dynamic load-balancing algorithms include:

动态算法根据当前或最近的服务器状态来做负载分配。它们与服务器通信，会产生通信开销。维护状态信息显著增加了算法设计的复杂度，但能带来更好的请求转发决策。一些著名的动态负载均衡算法包括：

Least connections

Servers with the fewest active connections receive new requests. This algorithm aims to distribute traffic to servers that are less busy, effectively managing the current server load. However, it may not consider server capacity, which can lead to potential load imbalances.

活动连接数最少的服务器接收新请求。这种算法旨在把流量分发到较不繁忙的服务器，有效管理当前服务器负载。然而，它可能不考虑服务器容量，这可能导致潜在的负载不均衡。

Least response time

This algorithm directs requests to the server with the quickest response time. It monitors servers' successful response times and channels traffic to the most responsive server, ensuring efficient resource utilization.

这种算法把请求引导到响应时间最快的服务器。它监控服务器的成功响应时间，并把流量引导到响应最快的服务器，确保高效的资源利用。

Least loaded

This algorithm assesses the current load on each server and directs new requests to the one with the least load. This dynamic approach ensures efficient resource distribution based on the current server's performance parameters, such as CPU and memory utilization.

这种算法评估每台服务器的当前负载，并把新请求引导到负载最小的那台。这种动态方式根据当前服务器的性能参数（例如 CPU 和内存利用率）确保高效的资源分发。

Static algorithms have predefined rules for distributing traffic, offering simplicity but potentially leading to uneven server loads. Dynamic algorithms adjust traffic

静态算法有预定义的流量分发规则，简单但可能导致服务器负载不均。动态算法根据实时服务器状况调整流量

Page 148

distribution based on real-time server conditions, providing better load balancing but potentially incurring higher processing overhead.

分发，提供更好的负载均衡，但可能带来更高的处理开销。

Selecting the appropriate load balancing algorithm depends on the specific requirements of an application or system. Some applications may benefit from static algorithms because of their simplicity, while others, especially those with varying server loads, may find dynamic algorithms more suitable.

选择合适的负载均衡算法取决于应用或系统的具体需求。有些应用可能因静态算法的简单性而受益，而另一些——尤其是服务器负载变化的应用——可能觉得动态算法更合适。

Understanding these load balancing algorithms is crucial for optimizing system performance and ensuring the efficient use of resources in diverse network environments. Different scenarios may demand the use of a specific algorithm or a combination of several algorithms to achieve the desired balance in workload distribution.

理解这些负载均衡算法对于优化系统性能、确保在多样网络环境中高效利用资源至关重要。不同场景可能需要使用特定算法或几种算法的组合，以在工作负载分发中达到期望的平衡。

Session Persistence in LBs

Static and dynamic algorithms must prioritize the health of hosting servers while maintaining a state to store session information for various clients. If session data isn't stored at a lower layer, such as a distributed cache or database, LBs take charge of managing it. In this section, we'll discuss stateful or stateless LBs based on how they handle and manage session information, as shown in Figure 5-3.

静态和动态算法必须优先考虑托管服务器的健康状况，同时维护一个状态来存储各客户端的会话信息。如果会话数据没有存储在更低层（例如分布式缓存或数据库），就由 LB 负责管理它。在本节中，我们将根据 LB 如何处理和管理会话信息，讨论有状态或无状态 LB，如图 5-3 所示。

Stateful Load Balancers

Stateful LBs, as shown on the left in Figure 5-3, maintain session information, keeping track of the state of each client-server interaction. They store data related to the ongoing sessions, such as session cookies or other session identifiers. This enables the LB to consistently direct subsequent requests from the same client to the server that originally handled the initial request, ensuring session persistence.

有状态 LB（如图 5-3 左侧所示）维护会话信息，跟踪每次客户端-服务器交互的状态。它们存储与进行中会话相关的数据，例如会话 cookie 或其他会话标识符。这使 LB 能够把同一客户端的后续请求一致地引导到最初处理初始请求的服务器，从而确保会话保持。

Sticky sessions, also known as session persistence or session affinity, are a mechanism used in load balancing to ensure that a user's requests are consistently directed to the same server within a server farm or a group of servers in stateful load balancing. Sticky sessions achieve this by "sticking" a user's session to a specific server for the duration of their session. After the initial connection, the LB will route subsequent

sticky session（粘性会话），也称为会话保持或会话亲和，是负载均衡中使用的一种机制，用于在有状态负载均衡中确保用户的请求被一致地引导到服务器群或一组服务器中的同一台。sticky session 的做法是：在用户会话期间，把用户会话“粘”到某台特定服务器上。初始连接建立后，LB 会把后续

Page 149

requests from that user to the same server. This can be implemented using various techniques:

来自该用户的请求路由到同一台服务器。这可以通过多种技术实现：

  • Cookie-based session affinity. The LB uses a session cookie generated during the initial connection to identify and route subsequent requests from the same user to the server indicated in the cookie.
    基于 cookie 的会话亲和。LB 使用在初始连接期间生成的会话 cookie 来识别并把来自同一用户的后续请求路由到 cookie 中指明的服务器。
  • Source IP affinity. Requests from a particular IP address are consistently directed to the same server. This method can be less effective in scenarios where users are behind network address translation (NAT) or use proxy servers.
    源 IP 亲和。来自特定 IP 地址的请求被一致地引导到同一台服务器。当用户位于网络地址转换（NAT）之后或使用代理服务器时，这种方法可能效果较差。

Sticky sessions are crucial for maintaining session state, ensuring that all user interactions and data associated with a session remain consistent and available on a specific server, even in a distributed server environment managed by an LB.

sticky session 对于维护会话状态至关重要，它确保与会话关联的所有用户交互和数据在特定服务器上保持一致和可用，即使在由 LB 管理的分布式服务器环境中也是如此。

The benefits of stateful load balancing include:

有状态负载均衡的好处包括：

  • Session persistence. Ensures that all requests from the same client during a session are directed to the same server, maintaining continuity for tasks or interactions that span multiple requests.
    会话保持。确保会话期间来自同一客户端的所有请求都被引导到同一台服务器，为跨多个请求的任务或交互维持连续性。
  • Efficient handling of stateful applications. Ideal for applications that require a continuous connection or state information across multiple requests and that should be processed on the same server, such as ecommerce platforms or banking systems.
    高效处理有状态应用。非常适合需要跨多个请求保持连续连接或状态信息、且应在同一台服务器上处理的应用，例如电商平台或银行系统。

Considerations for stateful load balancing include:

有状态负载均衡需要考量之处包括：

  • Resource overhead. Maintaining session information requires additional memory and processing, potentially affecting the LB's performance. This requires extra resources but also saves external resources, such as the database, and it removes the network call to the database, improving the network latency.
    资源开销。维护会话信息需要额外的内存和处理，可能影响 LB 的性能。这需要额外资源，但也节省了外部资源（例如数据库），并且省去了对数据库的网络调用，从而改善网络延迟。
  • Scalability challenges. The need to maintain the session state across multiple servers can lead to limitations in scaling.
    可扩展性挑战。跨多台服务器维护会话状态的需求可能带来扩展上的限制。

Stateless Load Balancers

Stateless LBs, as shown on the right in Figure 5-3, do not retain session information or state data. Each request is treated independently, and there's no knowledge or tracking of previous interactions between clients and servers. Requests are distributed

无状态 LB（如图 5-3 右侧所示）不保留会话信息或状态数据。每个请求被独立处理，不了解也不跟踪客户端与服务器之间之前的交互。请求被分发

Page 150

purely based on the load balancing algorithm without any consideration for session continuity.

纯粹基于负载均衡算法，而不考虑会话连续性。

The benefits of stateless load balancing include:

无状态负载均衡的好处包括：

  • Scalability. Stateless LBs are highly scalable because they do not need to maintain session information. Requests can be easily directed to any available server without considering previous interactions.
    可扩展性。无状态 LB 高度可扩展，因为它们不需要维护会话信息。请求可以轻松地被引导到任何可用服务器，而无需考虑之前的交互。
  • Simplicity and efficiency. These LBs are generally less complex and can efficiently distribute traffic without the overhead of session management.
    简单高效。这些 LB 通常复杂度较低，能够高效分发流量而没有会话管理的开销。

The choice between stateful and stateless load balancing depends on the requirements of the application or system. Applications requiring session continuity benefit from stateful LBs, whereas those emphasizing scalability and simplicity are better suited to stateless LBs. A combination of both types is often employed in complex network architectures to address diverse needs.

在有状态与无状态负载均衡之间的选择取决于应用或系统的需求。需要会话连续性的应用受益于有状态 LB，而那些强调可扩展性和简单性的应用更适合无状态 LB。在复杂网络架构中，常结合使用两种类型来满足多样需求。

Evaluate your business use case before finalizing the solution, but one simple and recommended solution is to use stateless LBs and leverage Redis or a similar data store for session management. We'll discuss a use case for building stateful servers at WhatsApp scale in Chapter 19.
在最终确定方案之前，请评估你的业务用例，但一个简单而推荐的方案是使用无状态 LB，并利用 Redis 或类似的数据存储来做会话管理。我们将在第 19 章讨论在 WhatsApp 规模下构建有状态服务器的用例。

Types of Load Balancers

Understanding the different types of LBs is essential for effectively managing traffic and ensuring seamless application delivery. In this section, we will explore the classification of LBs based on functionality and configuration.

理解不同类型的 LB 对于有效管理流量和确保无缝的应用交付至关重要。在本节中，我们将探讨基于功能和配置对 LB 的分类。

LB Types Based on Functionality

LBs can be categorized based on their functionality into different types, each serving specific needs and requirements. Let's delve into the details of DNS LBs, equal-cost multipath (ECMP) routers, and network and application LBs.

LB 可以根据其功能分为不同类型，每种服务于特定需求。下面我们详细了解 DNS LB、等价多路径（ECMP）路由器，以及网络层和应用层 LB。

DNS load balancers

DNS LBs distribute traffic at the DNS level by resolving domain names to different IP addresses based on predefined policies, serving as tier-0 LBs. They are easy to set up and can provide basic load balancing functionality but may lack some advanced features compared to L4 and L7 LBs. Some examples of DNS load balancers are Amazon Route 53 and Azure Traffic Manager.

DNS LB 在 DNS 层分发流量，根据预定义策略把域名解析到不同 IP 地址，充当 tier-0 LB。它们易于搭建，可以提供基本的负载均衡功能，但与 L4 和 L7 LB 相比可能缺少一些高级特性。DNS 负载均衡器的一些例子有 Amazon Route 53 和 Azure Traffic Manager。

Page 151

ECMP routers

ECMP routers are a method of load balancing typically used at the network layer as a tier-1 LB. They distribute traffic across multiple paths or links with equal cost, enabling efficient utilization of network resources and providing fault tolerance. ECMP routers operate by hashing packet headers to determine the appropriate path for each packet, ensuring that traffic is evenly distributed among available links. This approach improves network performance and reliability by leveraging multiple paths simultaneously. Some examples of ECMP routers are Cisco Nexus switches and Juniper Networks routers.

ECMP 路由器是一种负载均衡方法，通常在网络层用作 tier-1 LB。它们把流量分发到多条代价相同的路径或链路上，从而高效利用网络资源并提供容错。ECMP 路由器通过对数据包报头做哈希来决定每个数据包的合适路径，确保流量在可用链路之间均匀分发。这种方式通过同时利用多条路径来提升网络性能和可靠性。ECMP 路由器的一些例子有 Cisco Nexus 交换机和 Juniper Networks 路由器。

Network load balancers (L4 LBs)

Operating at the transport layer (L4) of the OSI model, network LBs handle traffic based on network variables like IP addresses and destination ports. These LBs distribute traffic at the transport level, making routing decisions solely based on network layer information. They primarily handle network-level protocols like IP, TCP, FTP, and UDP. L4 LBs are often implemented as NATs, which distribute traffic among backend servers.

网络层 LB 在 OSI 模型的传输层（L4）运行，基于 IP 地址和目的端口等网络变量处理流量。这些 LB 在传输层分发流量，仅基于网络层信息做路由决策。它们主要处理 IP、TCP、FTP 和 UDP 等网络层协议。L4 LB 通常实现为 NAT，在后端服务器之间分发流量。

Some features of L4 LBs include:

L4 LB 的一些特性包括：

  • Session persistence at the IP address level. L4 LBs can achieve session persistence by maintaining consistency at the IP address level. This ensures that subsequent requests from the same client are directed to the same backend server.
    IP 地址级别的会话保持。L4 LB 可以通过在 IP 地址级别保持一致性来实现会话保持。这确保来自同一客户端的后续请求被引导到同一台后端服务器。
  • No termination for TCP connections. Unlike L7 LBs, L4 LBs do not terminate TCP connections. Instead, they forward incoming traffic to backend servers without inspecting the content of the packets. Network LBs are ideal for efficiently managing TCP traffic and are commonly used in scenarios where basic load balancing is sufficient.
    不终结 TCP 连接。与 L7 LB 不同，L4 LB 不终结 TCP 连接。相反，它们把进入的流量转发到后端服务器，而不检查数据包内容。网络 LB 非常适合高效管理 TCP 流量，常用于基本负载均衡即可满足的场景。

L4 LBs operate in the following two modes:

L4 LB 以下面两种模式运行：

  • Direct server return (DSR) mode. In this mode, the TCP connection is established directly between the client and the backend server. The LB changes only the destination MAC address of the packets, allowing backend servers to respond directly to clients. This mode ensures that the LB does not become a bottleneck for outgoing traffic. DSR mode can be useful for scenarios like WebSocket connections and large reply traffic as compared to the request (e.g., downloading an object from Amazon S3).
    直接服务器返回（DSR）模式。在这种模式下，TCP 连接直接在客户端与后端服务器之间建立。LB 只更改数据包的目的 MAC 地址，让后端服务器直接响应客户端。这种模式确保 LB 不会成为出站流量的瓶颈。DSR 模式对于 WebSocket 连接、以及响应流量远大于请求的场景（例如从 Amazon S3 下载对象）很有用。
  • NAT mode. Clients connect to the service VIP and the LB forwards packets to backend servers by changing the destination IP address (or DNAT). The LB becomes the
    NAT 模式。客户端连接到服务 VIP，LB 通过更改目的 IP 地址（即 DNAT）把数据包转发到后端服务器。LB 成为
Page 152

default gateway for backend servers, and all traffic passes through it. This mode limits the output bandwidth to the LB's capacity and hides the backend server information from the clients, enhancing security.

后端服务器的默认网关，所有流量都经过它。这种模式把输出带宽限制在 LB 的容量内，并向后端服务器信息对客户端隐藏，从而增强安全性。

Some examples of network LBs are AWS Network Load Balancer (NLB), Azure Load Balancer, nginx configured as a TCP, and UDP load balancer.

网络 LB 的一些例子有 AWS Network Load Balancer（NLB）、Azure Load Balancer，以及配置为 TCP 和 UDP 负载均衡器的 nginx。

Application load balancers (L7 LBs)

Application LBs operate at the application layer (L7) of the OSI model, enabling them to make routing decisions based on application-specific parameters. These LBs consider factors like HTTP headers, cookies, and content to distribute traffic intelligently, optimizing application performance and enhancing security. Application LBs are well suited for complex applications and environments requiring advanced routing capabilities.

应用层 LB 在 OSI 模型的应用层（L7）运行，使其能够基于应用特定参数做路由决策。这些 LB 考虑 HTTP 头、cookie 和内容等因素来智能分发流量，优化应用性能并增强安全性。应用层 LB 非常适合需要高级路由能力的复杂应用和环境。

Some features of L7 LBs include:

L7 LB 的一些特性包括：

  • Distribution based on application layer protocols. L7 LBs distribute requests based on application layer protocols like HTTP. They can further distribute requests based on specific data within the application message and can be used to distribute read and write workloads.
    基于应用层协议分发。L7 LB 基于 HTTP 等应用层协议分发请求。它们可以进一步根据应用消息中的特定数据分发请求，可用于分发读和写工作负载。
  • Session persistence with cookies. L7 LBs can achieve session persistence by using cookies to keep track of client sessions. This ensures that subsequent requests from the same client are directed to the same backend server. This can be helpful in scenarios such as ecommerce shopping carts, where a user session is started from wherever the user left off earlier.
    用 cookie 做会话保持。L7 LB 可以通过使用 cookie 跟踪客户端会话来实现会话保持。这确保来自同一客户端的后续请求被引导到同一台后端服务器。这在电商购物车等场景中很有用，用户会话可以从之前离开的地方继续。
  • Connection termination. To extract HTTP information, L7 LBs terminate the connection at the LB, resulting in two TCP connections: one between the client and the LB and another between the LB and the backend server. One example is SSL/TLS offloading at the load balancer and decrypted traffic being forwarded to the backend servers over HTTP or another protocol. This is helpful for simplifying the processing on backend servers, and backend servers don't need to maintain the SSL certificate for request verification.
    连接终结。为了提取 HTTP 信息，L7 LB 在 LB 处终结连接，从而产生两条 TCP 连接：一条在客户端与 LB 之间，另一条在 LB 与后端服务器之间。一个例子是在负载均衡器处做 SSL/TLS 卸载，解密后的流量通过 HTTP 或其他协议转发到后端服务器。这有助于简化后端服务器上的处理，后端服务器不需要为请求验证而维护 SSL 证书。

Some examples of application LBs are AWS Application Load Balancer (ALB), Azure Application Gateway, and nginx configured as an HTTP LB.

应用层 LB 的一些例子有 AWS Application Load Balancer（ALB）、Azure Application Gateway，以及配置为 HTTP LB 的 nginx。

Understanding the differences between these types of LBs is crucial for selecting the appropriate solution based on the specific requirements of your application or infrastructure. Whether you need basic network-level load balancing or advanced application-aware routing, there's an LB type to suit your needs.

理解这些 LB 类型之间的差异，对于根据你的应用或基础设施的具体需求选择合适方案至关重要。无论你需要基本的网络层负载均衡还是高级的应用感知路由，都有适合你需求的 LB 类型。

Page 153

LB Types Based on Configuration

LBs can be configured as hardware, as software, or on the cloud. The correct configuration helps with cost-effective scaling, fault tolerance, and seamless integration with your infrastructure, enabling efficient management of traffic and resources. LBs can thus be categorized based on their configuration into two main types: hardware and software.

LB 可以配置为硬件、软件或云上形式。正确的配置有助于经济高效的扩展、容错以及与你的基础设施无缝集成，从而高效管理流量和资源。因此，LB 可以根据配置分为两大类型：硬件和软件。

Hardware LBs

Hardware LBs are physical devices dedicated to load balancing tasks. These appliances require proprietary hardware and are typically deployed in data centers or on-premises environments, operating as standalone units and capable of handling large volumes of concurrent users. While hardware LBs offer high performance and reliability, they can be expensive to procure and maintain. Additionally, their scalability may be limited by the hardware infrastructure. Their configuration can be resource intensive, making them less favorable even for sizable enterprises. Availability might pose challenges because of the need for additional hardware for failover in case of failures. Maintenance and compatibility issues, along with vendor lock-ins, limit their flexibility. Some examples of hardware LBs are F5 BIG-IP Load Balancer, Cisco System Catalyst, and Citrix NetScaler.

硬件 LB 是专用于负载均衡任务的物理设备。这些设备需要专有硬件，通常部署在数据中心或本地环境中，作为独立单元运行，能够处理大量并发用户。虽然硬件 LB 提供高性能和高可靠性，但采购和维护成本可能很高。此外，它们的可扩展性可能受硬件基础设施限制。其配置可能耗费大量资源，即使对大型企业也不太受欢迎。可用性可能构成挑战，因为故障时需要额外硬件做故障切换。维护和兼容性问题，加上厂商锁定，限制了它们的灵活性。硬件 LB 的一些例子有 F5 BIG-IP Load Balancer、Cisco System Catalyst 和 Citrix NetScaler。

Software LBs

Software LBs are implemented as software applications running on standard server hardware or virtual machines. They scale effectively as demands increase, and they ensure availability by enabling the implementation of shadow LBs at minimal extra cost. They offer greater flexibility, scalability, and adaptability than hardware LBs because they can be deployed on commodity hardware or in cloud environments. Software LBs are cost-effective alternatives to hardware solutions and are well suited for dynamic or cloud-based infrastructures. Moreover, these solutions offer predictive analysis to support preparations for future traffic patterns. Some examples of software LBs are HAProxy and nginx.

软件 LB 实现为运行在标准服务器硬件或虚拟机上的软件应用。它们随需求增长而有效扩展，并通过以最小额外成本实现 shadow LB（影子 LB）来确保可用性。它们比硬件 LB 提供更大的灵活性、可扩展性和适应性，因为可以部署在通用硬件或云环境中。软件 LB 是硬件方案的经济高效替代，非常适合动态或基于云的基础设施。此外，这些方案提供预测性分析，以支持为未来流量模式做准备。软件 LB 的一些例子有 HAProxy 和 nginx。

In the realm of cloud computing, load balancer as a service (LBaaS) has emerged, where cloud providers offer load balancing services. Users pay according to usage or the service-level agreement (SLA). The key advantages of LBaaSs are ease of use, flexibility, metered costs, and robust auditing and monitoring services, which can enhance business decision making.
在云计算领域，负载均衡即服务（LBaaS）已经出现，由云提供商提供负载均衡服务。用户根据使用量或服务水平协议（SLA）付费。LBaaS 的主要优势是易用、灵活、按量计费，以及强健的审计和监控服务，这些都能增强业务决策。

Understanding the different types of LBs and their respective characteristics is essential for designing resilient, scalable application architectures. By selecting the appropriate load balancing solution based on functionality and configuration

理解不同类型的 LB 及其各自特征，对于设计有弹性、可扩展的应用架构至关重要。通过基于功能和配置

requirements, organizations can optimize resource utilization, enhance application performance, and ensure seamless user experiences.

需求选择合适的负载均衡方案，各组织可以优化资源利用、提升应用性能，并确保无缝的用户体验。

To close out this chapter, let's dive deeper into one popular open source load balancing solution to understand its details and how it implements the concepts discussed in the chapter.

在本章收尾之际，让我们深入了解一种流行的开源负载均衡解决方案，弄清它的细节以及它如何实现本章讨论的概念。

Nginx: Open Source Load Balancer

Nginx is a high-performance open source web server and reverse proxy server renowned for its efficiency, scalability, and versatility. In addition to its core functionalities as a web server and reverse proxy, nginx serves as a powerful LB, providing advanced capabilities for distributing incoming traffic across multiple backend servers. Nginx's load balancing features include:

Nginx 是一个高性能的开源 Web 服务器和反向代理服务器，以其高效、可扩展和多功能而闻名。除了作为 Web 服务器和反向代理的核心功能外，nginx 还充当强大的 LB，提供把进入流量分发到多台后端服务器的高级能力。Nginx 的负载均衡特性包括：

  • L4 and L7 load balancing. Nginx offers both L4 (transport layer) and L7 (application layer) load balancing capabilities, allowing users to distribute traffic based on various factors, such as IP addresses, TCP/UDP ports, HTTP headers, cookies, and content.
    L4 和 L7 负载均衡。Nginx 同时提供 L4（传输层）和 L7（应用层）负载均衡能力，允许用户基于各种因素分发流量，例如 IP 地址、TCP/UDP 端口、HTTP 头、cookie 和内容。
  • Various load balancing algorithms. Nginx supports a range of load balancing algorithms to suit different use cases and requirements. These include round robin, least connections, IP hash, and more. Users can configure the desired algorithm to optimize traffic distribution based on factors like server load, response time, and session persistence.
    多种负载均衡算法。Nginx 支持一系列负载均衡算法以适应不同用例和需求，包括 round robin、least connections、IP hash 等。用户可以配置所需算法，根据服务器负载、响应时间和会话保持等因素优化流量分发。
  • Health checking and failure detection. Nginx continuously monitors the health of backend servers through configurable health checks. It automatically detects failed or degraded servers and removes them from the load balancing pool, ensuring that traffic is routed only to healthy servers. This proactive approach enhances application availability and reliability.
    健康检查与故障检测。Nginx 通过可配置的健康检查持续监控后端服务器的健康状况。它自动检测故障或降级的服务器，并把它们从负载均衡池中移除，确保流量只路由到健康服务器。这种主动方式增强了应用的可用性和可靠性。
  • Dynamic configuration updates. Nginx allows for dynamic configuration updates, enabling seamless scaling and reconfiguration of load balancing settings without requiring service interruption or manual intervention. This flexibility is particularly beneficial in dynamic or cloud-based environments where infrastructure changes frequently.
    动态配置更新。Nginx 允许动态配置更新，从而无需中断服务或人工干预即可无缝地扩展和重新配置负载均衡设置。这种灵活性在基础设施频繁变化的动态或云环境中尤其有益。

Nginx implements the following load balancing concepts, which we discussed in detail in this chapter:

Nginx 实现了以下我们在本章详细讨论过的负载均衡概念：

  • Reverse proxy load balancing. Nginx serves as a reverse proxy, intercepting incoming client requests and distributing them across multiple backend servers. By offloading tasks like SSL termination, content caching, and compression, nginx enhances security, scalability, and performance of web applications.
    反向代理负载均衡。Nginx 充当反向代理，拦截进入的客户端请求并把它们分发到多台后端服务器。通过卸下 SSL 终结、内容缓存和压缩等任务，nginx 增强了 Web 应用的安全性、可扩展性和性能。
Page 155
  • HTTP load balancing. With its comprehensive support for HTTP-based load balancing, nginx can intelligently distribute HTTP requests based on various criteria, such as URL paths, HTTP headers, and cookies. This allows for advanced routing and traffic shaping, improving application performance and user experience.
    HTTP 负载均衡。凭借对基于 HTTP 负载均衡的全面支持，nginx 可以基于 URL 路径、HTTP 头和 cookie 等多种标准智能分发 HTTP 请求。这支持高级路由和流量整形，提升应用性能和用户体验。
  • TCP and UDP load balancing. Nginx extends its load balancing capabilities beyond HTTP to support TCP and UDP protocols. This enables users to distribute non-HTTP traffic, such as database queries, DNS requests, and gaming traffic, across multiple backend servers, enhancing scalability and reliability for diverse applications.
    TCP 和 UDP 负载均衡。Nginx 把负载均衡能力扩展到 HTTP 之外，支持 TCP 和 UDP 协议。这让用户可以把非 HTTP 流量（例如数据库查询、DNS 请求和游戏流量）分发到多台后端服务器，为多样应用增强可扩展性和可靠性。
  • Session persistence. Nginx offers session persistence mechanisms to ensure that subsequent requests from the same client are directed to the same backend server. This is achieved through techniques like IP hash load balancing, where requests from a specific client IP address are consistently routed to a particular backend server, maintaining session continuity.
    会话保持。Nginx 提供会话保持机制，确保来自同一客户端的后续请求被引导到同一台后端服务器。这通过 IP hash 负载均衡等技术实现，即来自特定客户端 IP 地址的请求被一致地路由到某台后端服务器，维持会话连续性。

At a high level, configuring nginx as a web server is a matter of defining which URLs it handles and how it processes requests for resources at those URLs. At a lower level, the configuration defines a set of virtual servers that control the processing of requests for particular domains or IP addresses.

从较高层面看，把 nginx 配置为 Web 服务器就是定义它处理哪些 URL、以及它如何处理对这些 URL 上资源的请求。从较低层面看，配置定义了一组虚拟服务器，控制对特定域名或 IP 地址请求的处理。

Here is what a simple nginx configuration looks like:

下面是一个简单 nginx 配置的样子：

http {
    upstream backend_servers {
        server 10.0.0.1:8080;
        server 10.0.0.2:8080;
        server 10.0.0.3:8080;
        server 10.0.0.4:8080;
    }

    server {
        listen 80;
        server_name example.com;

        location / {
            proxy_pass http://backend_servers;
            # Additional proxy settings can be configured here
        }
    }
}

In this example configuration, nginx is configured as a reverse proxy and LB. Incoming HTTP requests to the domain example.com are proxied to a pool of backend servers defined in the upstream block. Nginx distributes the requests across the backend servers using its default round-robin load balancing algorithm.

在这个示例配置中，nginx 被配置为反向代理和 LB。发往域名 example.com 的进入 HTTP 请求被代理到 upstream 块中定义的后端服务器池。Nginx 使用其默认的 round-robin 负载均衡算法把请求分发到各后端服务器。

Nginx shines as a versatile and powerful open source web server, serving as a potent LB. Whether it's managing web applications, API services, or other networked systems, nginx ensures scalability, reliability, and performance optimization for modern distributed architectures.

Nginx 作为一个多功能而强大的开源 Web 服务器表现出色，同时充当有力的 LB。无论是管理 Web 应用、API 服务还是其他网络化系统，nginx 都为现代分布式架构确保可扩展性、可靠性和性能优化。

Conclusion

This chapter provided a comprehensive overview of load balancing, touching on its benefits, deployment strategies, placement techniques, algorithms, session-persistence mechanisms, and various types of LBs distinguished by their functionality and configuration. We've seen how load balancing plays a pivotal role in enhancing system performance, scalability, and fault tolerance, making it an important component of modern system design. Understanding the intricacies of load balancing equips you with the knowledge necessary to architect robust, resilient systems capable of efficiently distributing workloads across resources.

本章全面概述了负载均衡，涉及它的好处、部署策略、放置技术、算法、会话保持机制，以及按功能和配置区分的各种 LB 类型。我们看到了负载均衡如何在提升系统性能、可扩展性和容错方面扮演关键角色，使之成为现代系统设计的重要组成部分。理解负载均衡的复杂之处，为你提供了构建健壮、有弹性、能够跨资源高效分发工作负载的系统所需的知识。
